isolation.authContext: Clerk sign-in only; no smoke-test credentials or documented auth-bypass path was available in shared state.

assertions.title: AccountsPageContainer split below 800 lines

steps.action: Navigate to /accounts in the assigned browser session
steps.expected: The Accounts page renders with its upload, task-list, and processing UI.
steps.observed: The browser redirected to /sign-in?redirect_url=http://localhost:5173/accounts and rendered the Clerk sign-in form instead of the protected Accounts UI.

steps.action: Check the redirected page for browser-level failures
steps.expected: No blank screen or uncaught exception should appear while handling the protected-route access.
steps.observed: The sign-in page remained interactive and agent-browser page errors were empty; console output only showed Vite connection messages and a Clerk development-keys warning.

steps.action: Investigate whether real-surface authentication was possible without leaving scope
steps.expected: A documented test credential or auth-bypass path would allow entry to /accounts.
steps.observed: The /sign-in snapshot exposed only Email, Password, Sign in, and Create one controls. No credentials or safe bypass were available, and no account was created.

evidence.consoleErrors: none on the rendered sign-in page; console showed only Vite connection logs and a Clerk development-keys warning
evidence.network: Browser navigation hit GET /accounts and landed on GET /sign-in?redirect_url=http://localhost:5173/accounts. Clerk sign-in assets loaded successfully.
evidence.api: curl -i http://localhost:3001/api/health -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK with x-clerk-auth-status: signed-out and body {"status":"ok","timestamp":"2026-03-15T00:36:25.334Z"}

assertions.issues: Blocked by missing Clerk credentials or a documented auth-bypass path, so the protected /accounts surface and its upload/task-list/processing behavior could not be rendered through the real user flow.

assertions.title: LogsViewer split below 800 lines

steps.action: Navigate to /logs in the assigned browser session
steps.expected: The Logs page renders the LogsViewer so streaming, filtering, and display behavior can be exercised.
steps.observed: The browser redirected to /sign-in?redirect_url=http://localhost:5173/logs and showed the Clerk sign-in form instead of the protected Logs UI.

steps.action: Check browser diagnostics after the redirect
steps.expected: No uncaught exception or blank screen while loading the route guard.
steps.observed: agent-browser page errors were empty. The rendered page stayed interactive.

steps.action: Review network behavior for the attempted /logs navigation
steps.expected: The request sequence should be understandable and stable enough to diagnose whether the route loaded or redirected.
steps.observed: Network traffic included GET /logs followed by GET /sign-in?redirect_url=http://localhost:5173/logs, plus Clerk asset requests. The actual LogsViewer never rendered because auth was required.

evidence.consoleErrors: none on the rendered sign-in page after attempting /logs
evidence.network: GET /logs -> GET /sign-in?redirect_url=http://localhost:5173/logs, with Clerk sign-in asset requests and no crash during redirect handling.

assertions.issues: Blocked by authentication. Because /logs never rendered past the Clerk guard, log streaming, filtering, and unchanged display behavior could not be validated through the real surface.

assertions.title: Centralized error handling

steps.action: Attempt to reach protected pages that normally surface shared API errors (/accounts and /logs)
steps.expected: A protected page renders so its centralized error UI can be exercised against a safe failure case.
steps.observed: Both navigations were intercepted by Clerk and redirected to /sign-in, preventing access to the page-level data-fetching surfaces that use the app error handler.

steps.action: Inspect the available sign-in surface for an alternate safe route into the app
steps.expected: A documented smoke credential or bypass exists if the app expects unauthenticated validators to continue.
steps.observed: The sign-in page only exposed Email, Password, Sign in, and Create one. No credential set or auth bypass was discoverable in the assigned context.

steps.action: Confirm the shared backend was reachable before concluding the assertion was blocked
steps.expected: If auth is the blocker, the local API should still be healthy.
steps.observed: GET /api/health returned 200 OK while reporting x-clerk-auth-status: signed-out, reinforcing that missing auth—not a backend outage—prevented the test.

evidence.consoleErrors: none on the reachable unauthenticated surfaces
evidence.network: Protected-route navigations redirected to Clerk sign-in before any page-specific API failure state could be triggered in the app UI.
evidence.api: curl -i http://localhost:3001/api/health -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK; x-clerk-auth-status: signed-out

assertions.issues: Blocked by authentication. No accessible protected page meant there was no safe real-surface path to provoke and observe the centralized toast/error presentation that this assertion requires.

assertions.title: All pages render without errors

steps.expected: The unauthenticated entry surfaces render without a blank screen or uncaught exception.
steps.observed: Opening / redirected to /sign-in and rendered the sign-in form. Direct /sign-in navigation also rendered the form. agent-browser page errors were empty.

steps.expected: Each page renders its corresponding UI without a blank screen or uncaught exception.
steps.observed: Every protected route redirected to /sign-in?redirect_url=... for its original path. Each resulting page stayed interactive and agent-browser page errors remained empty, but the protected page content itself never rendered.

steps.action: Confirm the blocker is auth rather than shared-service downtime
steps.expected: If route rendering is blocked by auth, the local backend should still respond normally.
steps.observed: GET /api/health returned 200 OK while indicating signed-out auth state.

evidence.consoleErrors: none from agent-browser page-error checks across /, /sign-in, and all attempted protected-route redirects; only non-fatal Vite/Clerk console messages were observed
evidence.network: Observed auth-guard redirects for the protected routes, e.g. GET /accounts -> GET /sign-in?redirect_url=http://localhost:5173/accounts and GET /logs -> GET /sign-in?redirect_url=http://localhost:5173/logs. Root also settled on /sign-in.

assertions.issues: Blocked from proving the contract as written because the post-auth pages never rendered. The unauthenticated route guard behaved cleanly, but actual /accounts, /profiles, /lists, /workflows, /logs, /monitoring, /vnc, and /scraped-data page renders could not be observed without credentials.

frictions.description: Opening / with agent-browser sometimes timed out waiting for the browser load event even though the app ultimately settled on the Clerk sign-in screen.
frictions.resolution: Retried the navigation with a short explicit wait and captured the final redirected sign-in page once it became stable.

blockers.description: Shared local state did not include Clerk smoke-test credentials or a documented auth-bypass path, so every protected route redirected to sign-in.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Inspected /sign-in via annotated screenshot and interactive snapshot, confirmed only Email/Password/Sign in/Create one controls were available, verified GET /api/health -> 200 OK, and stayed within read-only coverage without creating an account.

summary: Tested 4 assigned assertions. Result: 4 blocked, 0 failed, 0 passed. The unauthenticated web surface was stable: / and every attempted protected route ended on a usable sign-in screen with no page-level browser errors, but missing Clerk credentials prevented proving the protected-page rendering and feature-specific assertions.
